paragraph: [A 2026 Intelwatch report says Angola's electoral roll is derived from the civil identity database](<https://executivedigest.sapo.pt/servicos-de-informacoes-angolanos-acedem-a-dados-biometricos-sem-controlo-judicial-relatorio/>). [Under a 2025 law, voters are entered automatically from that database](<https://executivedigest.sapo.pt/servicos-de-informacoes-angolanos-acedem-a-dados-biometricos-sem-controlo-judicial-relatorio/>), so registration in person is no longer needed. In the last twelve months, [the justice minister said in July 2026 that the citizens database and the ID database exchange data](<https://angop.ao/noticias/politica/cerca-de-16-milhoes-de-cidadaos-constam-da-base-do-bilhete-de-identidade/>). The exchange keeps the electoral register up to date. No source found since October 2023 says the roll was published or that voters could check it online, by text message or at centres. Operating would need a source showing the roll was published or open to voters to check, online, by text message or at centres.

[The CENI president said in 2026 that a voter who loses a card can still vote](<https://www.sosmediasburundi.org/en/2026/09/03/2027-presidential-election-more-than-one-million-new-voters-ceni-accelerates-preparations/>), provided the voter is registered in the electoral database. In the last twelve months, [SOS Medias Burundi reported his statement in 2026](<https://www.sosmediasburundi.org/en/2026/09/03/2027-presidential-election-more-than-one-million-new-voters-ceni-accelerates-preparations/>). No source since October 2023 says the roll was published, or that voters could check their entries online, by text message or at centres. None says the roll is drawn from the national ID, population or civil register. Operating would need a source showing the roll was published or open to voters to check, online, by text message or at centres.

ANIP [displayed the computerised provisional electoral list in all voting centres from 13 to 28 September 2025](<https://beninwebtv.bj/affichage-de-la-liste-electorale-provisoire-lanip-lance-la-phase-de-verification/>). Voters could check their voting centre by phone or in the Anipbenin.bj app, using their NPI, and ask for corrections or transfers. [Electoral lists are generated automatically from the national register of persons, the RNPP](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [ANIP said in 2026 that its USSD channel is used heavily to consult and transfer voters](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-2-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). [A death recorded in the RNPP removes the person from the electoral lists automatically](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-2-Benin-FINAL.pdf>).

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether Burkina Faso's voters' roll is kept digitally. The earlier facts found about the roll date from before October 2023. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source from the past three years says how the roll is compiled, whether voters could check it, or whether it is drawn from the national ID, population or civil register. Establishing would need a source from the past three years saying a digital or biometric voter register is in service.

The 2026/27 budget [gives the Independent Electoral Commission BWP 50 million for electronic voter registration systems](<https://botswanaspeaks.gov.bw/media/COMMITTEE%20OF%20SUPPPLY%20SPEECHES/IEC.pdf>), work that may span two or three financial years. In September 2024 [the IEC secretary said the public may inspect each new roll for 80 days](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/81588>). The IEC gives out hard copies only, with no soft copies and no online roll. In the last twelve months, [the IEC said in June 2026 that it is modernising registration before the 2029 election](<https://www.mmegi.bw/news/iec-pushes-for-digital-election-reforms/news>). No source found since October 2023 says a digital or biometric voter register is in service. Establishing would need a digital or biometric voter register in service.

In 2024 the ANE [prepared a biometric registration drive with GenKey software and 3,000 enrolment tablets](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202410/central-african-republic-in-full-biometric-voter-registration-preparations>) and [enrolled 567,748 voters in its first area between 24 November and 24 December 2024](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2025/02/07/centrafrique-lautorite-nationale-des-elections-presente-les-resultats-de-revision-du-fichier-electorale-dans-laire-n-1/>). [The ANE published the definitive list of 2,398,158 voters on 23 August 2025](<https://french.xinhuanet.com/20250825/216678a5ca894a1d915b2f5528ff0973/c.html>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

The Independent Electoral Commission [published the definitive 2024-2025 roll of 8,727,431 voters on 2 June 2025](<https://cei.ci/point-de-presse-relatif-a-larret-de-la-liste-electorale-definitive-2025/>). It is a biometric file. [From 4 June 2025 voters could consult the roll on the Commission's website](<https://cei.ci/point-de-presse-relatif-a-larret-de-la-liste-electorale-definitive-2025/>), and could also check by SMS on any mobile network. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[ELECAM put the electoral roll online at www.elecam.cm from 10 July 2025](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/presidentielle-2025-cameroun-le-corps-electoral-convoque-le-fichier-electoral-disponible-sur-www-elecam-cm-consultez/>). Voters registered between 2012 and 2024 could check their entries there and lodge claims. [ELECAM said in 2025 that it was deduplicating its biometric voter registry of about 8.2 million voters](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202509/cameroon-signals-urgency-on-biometric-voter-id-collection-as-presidential-vote-nears>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

In December 2023 [CENI said enrolled voters could use its mobile app to look up their polling station](<https://ouragan.cd/2023/12/une-application-mobile-mise-a-jour-pour-consulter-les-electeurs>). Voters search with an 11-digit number or the QR code on their voter card. In the last twelve months, [CENI handed the electoral file of voters enrolled in 2022 to ONIP in February 2026](<https://actualite.cd/2026/02/19/identification-de-la-population-en-rdc-la-ceni-transmet-officiellement-le-fichier>). [ONIP, the identity office, draws on CENI's database](<https://www.bbc.com/afrique/articles/cy633p6ezq1o>), so the link found runs from the electoral file to ID. No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the ID register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[L'Horizon Africain wrote in September 2025 that the revision of the electoral lists was done by hand](<https://www.lhorizonafricain.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/302.pdf>). [The government had promised biometrics for the 2026 presidential election](<https://www.lhorizonafricain.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/302.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the provisional lists were open for consultation and claims in administrative districts from 3 to 16 December 2025](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/presidentielle-2026-des-listes-electorales-provisoires-deja-disponibles-168295>). A roll kept by hand does not count as open for checking. No source since October 2023 says a digital or biometric roll is procured, piloted or in service. Preparing would need a digital or biometric voter register procured or piloted.

No stage is set. [A UNDP project page says a biometric electoral file was built for the Comoros](<https://www.undp.org/fr/comoros/projets/projet-dappui-la-modernisation-du-fichier-electoral-de-lunion-des-comores>), enrolling 70% of voting-age citizens, and that the voter list for the 2015 elections came from it. [The Francophonie electoral mission reported that voter lists were posted outside every polling station it visited](<https://www.lexterieur.com/la-une/international/legislatives-aux-comores-la-declaration-preliminaire-de-la-mission-electorale-de-la-francophonie>) at the legislative elections of 12 January 2025. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a digital or biometric voter register is procured, piloted or in service. Establishing would need a digital or biometric voter register in service.

[The CNE president said in December 2024 that the electoral database, created in 2007, is outdated](<https://cne.cv/sala_de_imprensa_/cne-reivindica-nova-base-de-dados-para-as-eleicoes-de-2026/>). In the last twelve months, [the CNE said the registers would be on display for consultation until 23 March 2026](<https://cne.cv/sala_de_imprensa_/legislativas-2026-recenseamento-suspenso-a-partir-de-13-de-marco/>). Claims for omissions or wrong entries were accepted until 28 March. [A DGAPE page says its diaspora system works with the national identification database, SNIAC](<https://dgape.cv/rediaspora/>). It registers citizens abroad automatically when they ask for a passport or ID card. No source says the national roll as a whole is drawn from or checked against the ID register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether Djibouti's voters' roll is kept digitally. The earlier facts found about the roll date from before October 2023. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source from the past three years says how the roll is compiled, whether voters could check it, or whether it is drawn from the national ID, population or civil register. Establishing would need a source from the past three years saying a digital or biometric voter register is in service.

[ANIE's president said in December 2023 that digitising registration had removed nearly a million duplicate entries from the electoral file](<https://www.lexpressquotidien.dz/2023/12/07/charfi-affirme-une-parfaite-maitrise-du-fichier-electoral/>) between 2021 and 2023. [In 2024 he said the file had been digitised in 2019 and is updated at each revision](<https://www.lejourdalgerie.com/charfi-annonce-le-plan-de-developpement-strategique-de-lanie-2022-2024-la-revision-exceptionnelle-des-listes-electorales-entamee/>). [ANIE launched a digital platform for revising the lists in Oran in October 2025](<https://ouest-tribune.dz/processus-electoral-lanie-enclenche-la-mutation-numerique-a-oran/>), as a pilot for the whole country. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 says the roll was published or that voters could check it online, by text message or at centres. Operating would need a source showing the roll was published or open to voters to check, online, by text message or at centres.

[Law 198/2017 tasks the National Elections Authority with preparing the voter database and keeping it clean](<https://www.elections.eg/images/pdfs/laws/NEAlaw2017-198_en.pdf>), and bases the database on national identification number data. [Voters can check their electoral status in the Authority's mobile app or on its website](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8137356>), entering their 14-digit national number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [The Authority announced on 19 September 2025 that its update of the voter database was complete](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8137356>). The update linked each entry to the national number to prevent duplicates and errors.

In the last twelve months, [NEBE launched its Mirchaye voter registration system on 5 January 2026](<https://nebe.org.et/en/node/1222>). Officers register voters on the Board's tablets at selected polling stations, and the remaining stations keep manual registers. [NEBE says nearly 5.5 million people obtained voter cards digitally](<https://capitalethiopia.com/2026/05/31/ballots-beyond-glitches-ethiopia-prepares-to-chart-its-next-five-years/>), with paper used where networks failed. [Its chair spoke in November 2025 of integrating registration with the Fayda digital ID](<https://www.dpgethiopia.org/news/dpg-heads-of-agencies-convene-to-advance-ethiopias-election-preparedness/>). No source says the roll was published or that voters could check it online, by text message or at centres. Operating would need a source showing the roll was published or open to voters to check, online, by text message or at centres.

[Gabon launched biometric voter registration on 2 January 2025, under the interior ministry](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202501/biometric-voter-registration-underway-in-gabon-ahead-of-presidential-vote>). Enrolment kits went out to add to the 850,000 names in the electoral database. [The interior ministry says citizens can check their entry and polling centre online](<https://web.archive.org/web/20251016105802/https://www.interieur.gouv.ga/9-actualites/601-verifiez-votre-inscription-et-consultez-votre-centre-de-vote-en-quelques-clics-/>), and the online check of September 2025 asks for their NIP and name. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[The Electoral Commission certified the 2024 voters register at 18,774,159 valid voters](<https://gna.org.gh/2024/11/ec-releases-summary-2024-certified-voters-register/>), of whom 18,640,811 have biometric data. In the last twelve months, [the Commission's director of electoral services said in August 2026 that the register is exhibited](<https://ghananewsonline.com.gh/ec-outlines-sweeping-reforms-to-strengthen-ghanas-electoral-system/>). Voters then have the right to object to names on the roll. No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[The Direction générale des élections gave the final figures of the permanent biometric electoral file in August 2025](<https://mediaguinee.com/2025/08/guinee-67-millions-delecteurs-inscrits-conakry-et-kankan-concentrent-presque-la-moitie/>). It held 6,768,458 voters, including those abroad. In the last twelve months, [the DGE and the civil registration office signed a convention on the biometric file in January 2026](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/01/conakry-la-dge-et-loneci-scellent-une-alliance-pour-un-fichier-electoral-fiable/>). [The convention makes the national register of persons the single official source of voter identification data](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/01/conakry-la-dge-et-loneci-scellent-une-alliance-pour-un-fichier-electoral-fiable/>). [A jurist writes that the registration drive launched in April 2025 built that register](<https://mediaguinee.com/2025/04/en-avant-pour-le-recensement-biometrique-par-sayon-mara/>) to extract the electoral file for the referendum and elections.

[The IEC opened a supplementary registration on 8 April 2026 with its own registration software and equipment](<https://gambiaj.com/news/politics/elections/iec-announces-start-of-supplementary-voter-registration-ahead-of-2026-elections/>), with teams at 730 centres. In the last twelve months, [the IEC displayed the provisional voters' list at 730 registration centres from 7 July 2026](<https://standard.gm/revising-courts-to-hear-1600-objections-after-voter-registration/>). Voters could check their details and lodge corrections, appeals and objections. [The objections period was extended to 27 July](<https://standard.gm/iec-extends-scrutiny-period-of-provisional-voter-list/>). No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[GTAPE's director-general said in 2025 that the voters are held in its databases](<https://ang.gw/eleicoes-gerais-gtate-anuncia-inscricao-de-966-152-eleitores-para-as-legislativas-e-presidenciais-de-novembro/>), for the elections of 23 November 2025. In the last twelve months, [GTAPE handed the National Elections Commission the updated rolls on 18 August 2026](<https://ang.gw/referendo-30-de-agosto-gtape-entrega-cadernos-eleitorais-a-cne/>). They listed 966,152 voters, in physical and electronic versions, for the referendum of 30 August. No source since October 2023 says the roll was published or that voters could check it online, by text message or at centres. Operating would need a source showing the roll was published or open to voters to check, online, by text message or at centres.

[The IEBC chair said in September 2025 that a new biometric registration module had been built into KIEMS](<https://www.iebc.or.ke/news/?Commission_resumes_Continuous_Voter_Registration_with_colourful_launch_at_Mashuuru_Primary_School_in_Kajiado=>). [The IEBC says registered voters can check their details by text message to 70000](<https://citizen.digital/article/how-to-verify-your-iebc-voter-registration-details-online-n366049>). [From 29 September 2025 Kenyans could also inspect their records at all 290 constituency offices](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/politics/iebc-turns-to-id-data-to-meet-voter-targets-5623352>). In the last twelve months, [a commissioner put the register at 22.1 million voters in April 2026](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/iebc-to-clean-voter-register-ahead-of-2027-polls/>). No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[A 2023 paper says Liberia's National Elections Commission uses a biometric voter registration system](<https://doi.org/10.22271/allresearch.2025.v11.i6d.12680>), which holds the voters' roll. The paper gives 2,471,617 registered voters in 2023. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 says the roll was published or that voters could check their entries online, by text message or at centres. None says the roll is drawn from the national ID, population or civil register. Operating would need a source showing the roll was published or open to voters to check, online, by text message or at centres.

[In February 2025 HNEC let voters check their registration by text message](<https://hnec.ly/2025/02/25/%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%81-%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AC%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%8A-%D8%9F/>), sending their national number to 17017. [In April 2025 HNEC published the voter lists for municipal elections](<https://libyareview.com/54785/560896-voters-registered-for-libyan-municipal-elections/>), with 560,896 voters. In the last twelve months, [HNEC's Decision 253 of December 2025 set up registration by text message and in person](<https://lawsociety.ly/legislation/%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B6%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7/>). [It defines updating the register as checking HNEC's databases against changes in the Civil Registry Authority's](<https://lawsociety.ly/legislation/%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B6%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7/>). No source says the check has been carried out. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[The IEC re-registered voters nationwide from 2024, at its offices and through an online portal](<https://publiceyenews.com/2024/10/16/800-000-ghost-voters-unearthed/>). [In 2024 it said the register then in use dated from 2001](<https://lestimes.com/?p=85440>). In the last twelve months, [the IEC told an AU mission in July 2026 that more than 579,520 citizens had registered on its modernised system](<https://sundayexpress.co.ls/?p=36187>). It said the system is integrated with the National Identity and Civil Registry. [In September 2026 it hired a private auditor to examine the roll, its servers and its registration systems](<https://lestimes.com/?p=91669>). No source since October 2023 says the roll was published or that voters could check it online, by text message or at centres. Operating would need a source showing the roll was published or open to voters to check, online, by text message or at centres.

[The Interior Minister said on 13 January 2026 that the ministry audited the electoral lists in its central information system](<https://article19.ma/accueil/archives/187994>). Of 382,170 new registrants, 254,740 came through the electoral-lists website. In the last twelve months, [Order 503-26 of March 2026 let registered voters view their own entries at listeselectorales.ma](<https://adala.justice.gov.ma/api/uploads/2026/10/13/Arr%C3%AAt%C3%A9%20du%20ministre%20de%20l'int%C3%A9rieur%20n%C2%B0%20503-26%20relatif%20au%20site%20%C3%A9lectronique%20r%C3%A9serv%C3%A9%20aux%20listes%20%C3%A9lectorales%20g%C3%A9n%C3%A9rales-1791891611199.pdf>). [In September 2026 the ministry said voters can also check by text message to 2727 or through the MonBV app](<https://en.hespress.com/145833-morocco-voters-can-check-polling-stations-by-text-website-or-mobile-app.html>). No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[Ceni's 2026 overhaul of the roll collects voter data mainly on paper forms](<https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202608050202.html>), with tablets in a limited number of centres. [An electoral agent told L'Express in August 2026 that no digitalisation was planned for it](<https://www.lexpress.mg/2026/08/elections-la-digitalisation-de-la-liste.html>). In the last twelve months, [Ceni received USD 750,000 of IT equipment from Japan and UNDP in October 2026](<https://newsmada.com/2026/10/24/liste-electorale-biometrique-la-ceni-et-ses-partenaires-preparent-le-terrain/>) to prepare a biometric list. [The government's programme of November 2025 says it will continue digitalising the roll](<http://central.mfb.gov.mg/assets/file/accueil/2025/PMO-PGE_VF.pdf>). No source since October 2023 says a digital or biometric roll is in service. Establishing would need a digital or biometric voter register in service.

[The AIGE trained 54 agents on 26 January 2026 on Elector mobile](<https://malijet.com/elections-presidentielles-et-legisliatives-au-mali/307835-mali--l-aige-forme-ses-agents-sur-le-logiciel--elector-mobile-.html>), the central software for the electoral file. [Under the amended electoral law the new list is posted at the commune, embassy or consulate at least seven days before the vote](<https://lessor.ml/posts/loi-electorale-les-articles-52-57-et-70-modifies-677641a527512>). In the last twelve months, [Bamada.net reported in October 2026 that the lists are drawn from the biometric civil-status database](<https://bamada.net/fichier-electoral-lheure-du-grand-nettoyage>), with the NINA as each voter's unique identifier. [The 2026 revision opened on 1 October](<https://bamada.net/fichier-electoral-lheure-du-grand-nettoyage>).

[The Commonwealth Observer Group says the CNE has used biometric voter registration since 2008](<https://comsec-web-static.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2025-09/mozambique-cog-report-2024.pdf>). It registered 17,169,239 voters for the 2024 elections, and the final register was published from 4 to 9 July 2024. Copies are displayed where registration brigades worked, and voters can scrutinise them and complain in writing. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

No stage is set. [The Electoral Commissioner's office ran voter registration from 16 to 30 May 2024](<https://defimedia.info/liste-electorale-plus-que-quelques-jours-pour-verifier-et-sinscrire>), at 43 registration centres. [Voters could check the register online at electoral.govmu.org](<https://defimedia.info/liste-electorale-plus-que-quelques-jours-pour-verifier-et-sinscrire>), by SMS or phone with their national identity card number, and at the centres. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a digital or biometric voters' roll is under way or in service. Preparing would need a digital or biometric voter register procured or piloted.

[The Malawi Electoral Commission said in April 2025 that its Election Management System held 7,202,756 valid voter records](<https://mec.org.mw/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/20250408-Speech-for-press-briefing-on-Voter-Transfers-and-Inspection-of-Voters-Register.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [MEC held an inspection of the register at registration centres on 30 and 31 May 2026](<https://mec.org.mw/30-june-2026-by-election-and-fresh-election/>). Voters could also check their entry by dialling a code on the TNM and Airtel networks. [Parliament made the national ID card the only proof of identity for voter registration](<https://mwnation.com/nrb-under-scrutiny/>). No source says the roll is drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register. Mature would need the roll drawn from or checked against the national ID, population or civil register.

[The ECN says its digital biometric registration system has been in use since 2014](<https://web.archive.org/web/20240615064053/https://omutumwa.com/2024/06/ecn-explains-slow-start-of-mobile-voter-registration-system/>), and an enhanced mobile system went into use on 3 June 2024. [Its fingerprint system removed 15,560 duplicate registrations from about 1.4 million voters in 2024](<https://www.namibian.com.na/over-15-500-duplicate-names-removed-from-voters-roll/>). [The Namibian reports that the final 2024 voters' roll was published and given to political parties to inspect](<https://www.namibian.com.na/over-15-500-duplicate-names-removed-from-voters-roll/>).
